identity_law.project_id: Durable human project identity. Never derived from a menu number or chat title.
identity_law.workstream_id: Durable Prometeo execution/coordination stream. One project may contain multiple workstreams.
identity_law.worker_instance_id: Disposable chat/agent participant identity. A new chat gets a new worker_instance_id when transport allows, while project_id remains stable.
identity_law.menu_number: Temporary presentation alias only. Never persisted as identity.
